name: CoverPlayer
summary: Offline, cover-first audio player for audiobooks, podcasts, radio plays, and music on Knulli.

notes: User-authorized experimental Knulli package for detected aarch64 glibc systems with a 640x480 through 1280x720 display; no real-device validation is recorded yet.

The reviewed upstream Knulli archive contains the launcher, AArch64 binary, bundled runtime libraries, license files, and an upstream MANIFEST.sha256. The Store verifies the pinned asset size and SHA-256 before extraction.

CoverPlayer stores progress, collections, bookmarks, language, and cache data under the configured SDL preference directory /userdata/system/configs/coverplayer and writes its launcher log under /userdata/system/logs.
The application browses user-selected media under /userdata and does not download remote code. Media directories remain outside the managed package destination.

evidence.note: Version-pinned Knulli ZIP; 3,039,732 bytes compressed, 7,056,515 bytes across extracted regular files, SHA-256 70131f9544ebdcdcde094d2a5d42e394fb00124654bfc7d7dc487572cfa53bb9. Upstream package verification passed for 60 files and 2 manifests.
Apache-2.0 project license reviewed at the tagged release commit; bundled dependency notices are included in the archive.
Upstream identifies Knulli as the primary target and documents Knulli background playback. This catalogue entry does not claim a verified device or firmware matrix.

The launcher installs its bundled library path, sets the SDL preference directory to /userdata/system/configs/coverplayer, writes /userdata/system/logs/coverplayer.log, and launches the reviewed local binary.

The release binary is ELF64 AArch64 and requires system SDL2 plus libc/libm/libgcc_s/libstdc++; SDL2_image, SDL2_ttf, mpg123, and their supporting libraries are bundled. Highest observed GLIBC symbol requirement is 2.27.

install.warning: Experimental package: Knulli installation and launch are not yet validated on a real device. Existing files are backed up; install updates through the Store.
